title: So… that / Such… that
summary: إزاي نقول «لدرجة إن» في الإنجليزي: so + صفة + that، و such + (a) + صفة + اسم + that.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: We use **so … that** and **such … that** to show the **result** of a very strong quality, quantity or feeling: **The idea was so simple that everyone understood it.**

blocks.text: في العربي بنقول: «الفكرة كانت **بسيطة لدرجة إن** كل الناس فهموها». الجملة فيها حاجتين: **صفة قوية** (بسيطة جدًا) و**نتيجة** حصلت بسببها (كل الناس فهموها).
في الإنجليزي بنعبّر عن «**لدرجة إن**» بطريقتين: **so … that** و**such … that**. المعنى واحد، الفرق بس في **الكلمة اللي جاية بعد so أو such**.

في الكتاب الدرس ده موجود في **Unit 9: Circles of Belonging**، درس **9.3 No One Left Behind** (Section B: Inclusion and Community Action)، جزء **Grammar Focus: so…that / such…that** (صفحة 117)، وبييجي تاني في **Consolidation Review E**. الأمثلة هناك عن مبادرة الـ **Buddy Bench** وإزاي فكرة صغيرة عملت أثر كبير.
الفكرة ببساطة: سبب قوي ← نتيجة

text: The first part shows the **degree** (how strong). The **that**-clause shows the **result**.

blocks.text: كل جملة من دول ليها **جزئين**:
يعني بنقول الصفة، ونعليها بـ so أو such علشان نقول «جدًا لدرجة»، وبعدين نقول **النتيجة** بعد that.

items.en: The bench was popular. A second one was added.
items.ar: جملتين منفصلين: سبب + نتيجة.

items.en: The bench was **so popular that** a second one was added.
items.ar: جملة واحدة: الدكة كانت مشهورة **لدرجة إن** اتضافت دكة تانية.

blocks.text: القاعدة الذهبية: بص على اللي بعدها

text: Use **so** before an adjective or adverb alone (or many / much / few / little). Use **such** before a noun (with or without an adjective).

blocks.text: القاعدة كلها في سؤال واحد: **فيه اسم (noun) بعد الصفة ولا لأ؟**

items: لو **مفيش اسم** (صفة لوحدها أو ظرف) ← **so**: so **simple** / so **quickly**.
لو **فيه اسم** ← **such**: such a simple **idea** / such caring **volunteers**.
لو الاسم بييجي بعد **many / much / few / little** ← **so**: so **many** students / so **much** support.

rows: The idea was **so simple that** everyone understood it.
She spoke **so confidently that** the class listened.
**So many students** joined **that** a second bench was added.
There was **so much noise that** I couldn't hear him.
**So few** people came **that** the event was cancelled.
It was **such a small idea that** few people expected it to work.
They were **such caring volunteers that** the whole school noticed.
She gave **such good advice that** I followed it.

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ
items: **such** فيها **ch** زي **ch**air = اسم. يعني **such ← اسم**.
**so** ← **s**ifa (صفة) لوحدها.
**a / an** بتيجي **بعد** such: such **a** … ✓ — مش a such ✗، ومش so a ✗.
**many / much / few / little** دايمًا مع **so** حتى لو بعدهم اسم.

blocks.text: مكان a / an: أكتر غلطة في الامتحان

text: Say **such a simple idea**. Do not say *a so simple idea*, *so a simple idea* or *such simple idea*.

blocks.text: Review E بتجيب سؤال بالشكل ده. بص على الأربع اختيارات دي واعرف ليه 3 منهم غلط:

items.en: ✗ It was **a so clever** plan that the whole class joined in.
items.ar: غلط: so مش بتيجي قبل اسم، وa مش مكانها.

items.en: ✗ It was **so a clever** plan that the whole class joined in.
items.ar: غلط: so قبل a مش مستخدمة في الإنجليزي العادي.

items.en: ✗ It was **such clever** plan that the whole class joined in.
items.ar: غلط: plan مفرد بيتعد فلازم a.

items.en: ✓ It was **such a clever** plan that the whole class joined in.
items.ar: صح: such + a + صفة + اسم مفرد.

blocks.text: ولو الاسم **جمع** أو **مبيتعدش** يبقى **من غير a**: such **kind people** / such **useful information** / such **bad weather**.

blocks.title: أسماء مبتتعدش (uncountable) خلي بالك منها
blocks.text: advice / information / support / news / weather / help / progress / furniture / homework — كلهم **من غير a**: such good advice ✓ — such a good advice ✗. ولو عايز تستخدم so: so much advice / so much support.
التحويل بين so و such (Rewrite)

text: You can often say the same idea with **so** or **such**: **The volunteers were so caring that…** = **They were such caring volunteers that…**

blocks.text: سؤال مشهور: «أعد كتابة الجملة باستخدام such بدل so» أو العكس. الطريقة:

rows: It was **such a simple idea** that…
حط It was + such + a + الصفة + الاسم.
جمع ← They were + such + الصفة + الاسم (من غير a).
It was **such a powerful message** that…
الاسم يبقى الفاعل + was + so + الصفة.
uncountable ← The advice was so good.

blocks.text: لاحظ إن **الضمير** بيتغير حسب الاسم: مفرد ← It was / He was / She was. جمع ← They were.
so that ≠ so … that

text: **so that** (together) shows **purpose**: **I sat on the bench so that someone would talk to me.** **so + adjective + that** shows **result**.

blocks.text: فيه تركيبة شبهها جدًا بس معناها مختلف:

items.en: He sat on the bench **so that** someone would talk to him.
items.ar: **so that** لازقين = **علشان / بهدف إن** (purpose). هنا هو قعد **علشان** حد يكلمه.

items.en: He was **so** lonely **that** he sat on the bench.
items.ar: **so + صفة + that** = **لدرجة إن** (result). كان وحيد لدرجة إنه قعد على الدكة.

blocks.text: الفرق ببساطة: لو فيه **صفة بين so و that** ← لدرجة إن (نتيجة). لو **so that لازقين** ← علشان (هدف).
so / such ولا too / enough؟

text: **too + adjective + to** shows a negative result (something is not possible). **adjective + enough + to** shows something is possible. **so / such … that** can show any result.

items.en: The boy was **too shy to** ask the others to play.
items.ar: too = زيادة عن اللزوم ← ما قدرش يسأل (نتيجة سلبية).

items.en: The boy was **so shy that** he didn't ask the others to play.
items.ar: نفس المعنى بـ so … that (لاحظ إننا كتبنا جملة كاملة بعد that).

items.en: The bench was big **enough for** three children.
items.ar: enough = كفاية. بييجي **بعد** الصفة.

blocks.text: في Review E كان من ضمن الاختيارات **too** و**enough** جنب so و such. خلي بالك: الجملة لو آخرها **that + جملة كاملة** ← so أو such، مش too ولا enough.
أمثلة من موضوعات الوحدة
الأمثلة دي كلها من جو **Unit 9**: الانتماء، الإحساس بالوحدة في المدرسة، الـ Buddy Bench، والمبادرات الصغيرة اللي بتفرق.

items.en: The playground was **so crowded that** nobody noticed the new boy.
items.ar: الملعب كان زحمة لدرجة إن محدش لاحظ الولد الجديد.

items.en: Exclusion is **such a quiet problem that** teachers often miss it.
items.ar: الاستبعاد مشكلة هادية لدرجة إن المدرسين كتير مبياخدوش بالهم منها.

items.en: **So many** children used the bench **that** the school bought another one.
items.ar: عيال كتير قوي استخدموا الدكة لدرجة إن المدرسة اشترت واحدة تانية.

items.en: She felt **so welcome** after joining the club **that** she never missed a meeting.
items.ar: حست إنها مرحب بيها لدرجة إنها ما فوّتتش ولا اجتماع.

items.en: They were **such friendly** classmates **that** I soon felt at home.
items.ar: كانوا زمايل لطاف جدًا لدرجة إني بسرعة حسيت إني في بيتي.

items.en: The mentor gave me **such useful feedback that** my next essay was much better.
items.ar: المرشد ادّاني ملاحظات مفيدة لدرجة إن المقال اللي بعده كان أحسن بكتير. (feedback مبتتعدش ← من غير a)

items.en: There was **so little** support for new students **that** many felt lost.
items.ar: الدعم للطلبة الجداد كان قليل جدًا لدرجة إن كتير منهم حسوا إنهم تايهين.

items.en: He spoke **so honestly** about his loneliness **that** the whole class listened.
items.ar: اتكلم بصراحة عن وحدته لدرجة إن الفصل كله سمعه. (honestly ظرف ← so)

items.en: It was **such an inspiring talk that** ten students volunteered the next day.
items.ar: كانت محاضرة ملهمة لدرجة إن 10 طلبة اتطوعوا تاني يوم. (an قبل inspiring لأنها بتبدأ بصوت متحرك)

items.en: The online campaign spread **so quickly that** the whole neighbourhood joined in.
items.ar: الحملة على النت انتشرت بسرعة لدرجة إن الحي كله شارك.

blocks.text: إزاي نستخدمها في الكتابة والـ JRE

text: In a personal narrative or a discursive essay, **so / such … that** makes your evidence stronger because it links a cause to a clear result.

blocks.text: الدرس ده بييجي جنب كتابة الـ **personal narrative** والـ **discursive essay** في الوحدة. so / such … that بتخلي كلامك أقوى لأنها بتربط **السبب** بـ**النتيجة** في جملة واحدة. شوف الفقرة دي:

text: **Justify:** Small inclusion projects can change a school. **Reason:** Loneliness is **such a hidden problem that** it often goes unnoticed. **Evidence:** For example, after our school introduced a Buddy Bench, **so many** students started playing together **that** the teachers reported fewer children sitting alone.

blocks.text: لاحظ: الجملة الأولى فيها **such + a + صفة + اسم**، والتانية فيها **so many + اسم جمع**. والنتيجة بعد that في الحالتين جملة كاملة (فاعل + فعل).

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ It was **so** a kind gesture that… ← ✓ It was **such a** kind gesture that…
✗ It was **a such** kind gesture that… ← ✓ It was **such a** kind gesture that… (a بعد such)
✗ They were **such kind** that… ← ✓ They were **so kind** that… (مفيش اسم بعد الصفة ← so)
✗ She gave me **such a good advice** that… ← ✓ She gave me **such good advice** that… (advice مبتتعدش)
✗ **Such many** students came that… ← ✓ **So many** students came that…
✗ The idea was **very** simple **that** everyone understood. ← ✓ The idea was **so** simple that… (very مبتيجيش مع that)
✗ The idea was so simple **so** everyone understood it. ← ✓ The idea was so simple **that** everyone understood it. (النتيجة بتبدأ بـ that)

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب بسرعة في الامتحان
items: بص على **الكلمة بعد الفراغ**: a / an ← **such**. صفة وبعدها اسم ← **such**. صفة لوحدها أو ظرف ← **so**. many / much / few / little ← **so**.
لو الاختيارات فيها **too** و**enough**: لو آخر الجملة **that + جملة كاملة** ← so أو such.
في سؤال «Complete with the appropriate structure ( such )»: متكتبش اللي بين القوسين وخلاص. لو بعده صفة لوحدها **حوّلها لـ so**. (زي Review E: The project was ___ (such) welcoming ← **so**)
في الدمج: السبب الأول + so / such، والنتيجة بعد **that**، وشيل كلمات زي «So» أو «As a result» من الجملة التانية.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer.**

text: The talk was ______ moving that several students cried.
a. such   b. so   c. too   d. enough

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b. so.** ليه؟ بعد الفراغ صفة لوحدها (moving) ومفيش اسم، وآخر الجملة that + جملة ← so. (too / enough مبيجوش مع that بالشكل ده)
**2) Only one sentence in each group is grammatically correct.**

text: a. They were such a helpful mentors that we all improved.
b. They were so helpful mentors that we all improved.
c. They were such helpful mentors that we all improved.
d. They were such helpful that we all improved.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c.** mentors جمع ← such + صفة + اسم جمع من غير a. (a) a مع جمع غلط. (b) so قبل اسم غلط. (d) such من غير اسم غلط.
**3) Combine the two sentences using so…that or such…that.**

text: The programme is successful. Other governorates want to copy it.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** The programme is **so successful that** other governorates want to copy it. **أو:** It is **such a successful programme that** other governorates want to copy it. الاتنين صح، واحدة بـ so (صفة لوحدها) والتانية بـ such (صفة + اسم).
تدريب
**A. Complete the sentences with so or such.**

items.q: 1. The new student was ______ quiet that nobody knew his name.
items.a: **so** — صفة لوحدها (quiet).

items.q: 2. It was ______ a warm welcome that I forgot my fears.
items.a: **such** — بعد الفراغ a.

items.q: 3. ______ many parents came to the meeting that some of them had to stand.
items.a: **So** — many دايمًا مع so.

items.q: 4. They are ______ kind neighbours that they check on my grandmother every day.
items.a: **such** — صفة + اسم جمع (neighbours).

items.q: 5. The workshop gave us ______ useful information that we used it at once.
items.a: **such** — information اسم مبيتعدش ومفيش a.

items.q: 6. He apologised ______ sincerely that his friend forgave him immediately.
items.a: **so** — sincerely ظرف.

items.q: 7. There was ______ little time that we couldn't finish the poster.
items.a: **so** — little دايمًا مع so.

blocks.text: **B. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
8. The Buddy Bench was ______ simple idea that many schools copied it.
a. so  b. such a  c. a such  d. so a
items.a: **b. such a** — idea مفرد بيتعد: such + a + صفة + اسم.

items.q:
9. The playground was so noisy ______ I couldn't hear my friend.
a. than  b. as  c. that  d. so
items.a: **c. that** — so … that = لدرجة إن.

items.q:
10. Her story was ______ that the whole school talked about it.
a. such inspiring  b. so inspiring  c. such an inspiring  d. too inspiring
items.a: **b. so inspiring** — صفة لوحدها ومفيش اسم بعدها.

items.q:
11. We had ______ bad weather that the charity run was postponed.
a. such a  b. so  c. such  d. so much
items.a: **c. such** — weather مبتتعدش ← such + صفة + اسم من غير a.

items.q:
12. Mona joined the art club ______ she could meet new friends.
a. so that  b. such that  c. so … that  d. too
items.a: **a. so that** — هنا الهدف (علشان تقابل أصحاب جداد) مش نتيجة.

items.q:
13. ______ few students attended the meeting that it was cancelled.
a. Such  b. Such a  c. So  d. Too
items.a: **c. So** — few دايمًا مع so.

blocks.text: **C. Combine each pair of sentences using so…that or such…that.**

items.q: 14. The campaign was powerful. Even adults started using its message at work.
items.a: The campaign was **so powerful that** even adults started using its message at work. — أو: It was **such a powerful campaign that** …

items.q: 15. Karim is a generous mentor. He spends his free time helping younger students.
items.a: Karim is **such a generous mentor that** he spends his free time helping younger students. — صفة + اسم مفرد ← such a.

items.q: 16. Many people offered help. The organisers had to refuse some of it.
items.a: **So many** people offered help **that** the organisers had to refuse some of it.

items.q: 17. The volunteers were patient. The shy children slowly began to join in.
items.a: The volunteers were **so patient that** the shy children slowly began to join in. — أو: They were **such patient volunteers that** …

blocks.text: **D. Rewrite each sentence as shown. Then find and correct the mistakes.**

items.q: 18. Rewrite using such: The idea was so effective that other schools adopted it.
items.a: It was **such an effective idea that** other schools adopted it. — an لأن effective بتبدأ بصوت متحرك.

items.q: 19. Rewrite using so: They were such supportive friends that I never felt alone.
items.a: My friends were **so supportive that** I never felt alone. — شلنا الاسم بعد الصفة فبقت so.

items.q: 20. Find and correct the mistake: It was so a long queue that we waited for an hour.
items.a: It was **such a** long queue that we waited for an hour. — قبل a لازم such.

items.q: 21. Find and correct the mistake: She gave me such a good advice that I followed it.
items.a: She gave me **such good advice** that I followed it. — advice مبتتعدش فمفيش a.

items.q: 22. Complete with the appropriate structure: The new club was (such) ______ friendly that I joined it on the first day.
items.a: **so** friendly — بعده صفة لوحدها، فلازم نحوّل such لـ so. (ده نفس شكل أسئلة Review E)

items.q: 23. Write ONE sentence about a small act of inclusion you have seen. Use such…that.
items.a: مثال: It was **such a small act of kindness that** I nearly missed it, but it made the new girl smile for the rest of the day.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: so / such … that = **لدرجة إن**: درجة قوية ← نتيجة بعد **that**.
**so** + صفة لوحدها أو ظرف، و**so many / much / few / little** + اسم.
**such** + (a / an) + صفة + **اسم**. مع الجمع والـ uncountable **من غير a**.
الترتيب: **such a** ✓ — مش a such ولا so a.
**so that** لازقين = علشان (هدف)، مش لدرجة إن.
